name: Marble Run Maker
summary: Offline 16 mm marble run builder with bundled Plain and Japandi high-resolution 3MF profiles.
description: A customized local mirror of the 16 mm Marble Run Builder, packaged with an Electron Windows wrapper. Runs without an account, cloud hosting or Internet access.
